short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in San Gabriel.
local_note: San Gabriel homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for San Gabriel's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout San Gabriel, including Mission District, Downtown San Gabriel, San Gabriel Blvd corridor, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in San Gabriel?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the San Gabriel building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in San Gabriel?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and San Gabriel rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my San Gabriel remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
